description: Golden pricing/tax/happy-hour dataset for this brand's persona pack (issue #79). Created preemptively per Rick's #79 review note anticipating a future per-persona conformance harness (tests/conformance/testdata/personas/<id>/ is not yet consumed by any C# fixture as of this PR -- see tests/conformance/src/Conformance.Harness/ConformancePersonas.cs's doc comment). MONEY CONTRACT: identical to tests/conformance/testdata/golden-order-pricing.json (the reference persona) -- line = unit * qty * (happyHourDiscount iff item is happy-hour-eligible per this pack's persona.json extras.allowedBaseCategories AND happy hour is active); subtotal = sum(line); tax = subtotal * taxRate computed ONCE per order; finalTotal = subtotal + tax. No rounding at any step; every money value is a quoted exact-decimal string. This brand has NO combos (persona.json bundles.nameMarkers is empty) and no 'Route 44'-style size-alias branding -- both sections are intentionally omitted rather than fabricated.

businessRules.source: this pack's persona.json (pricing.taxRate, pricing.happyHour) + app/backend/config.yaml business_rules block (maxItemQuantity/maxOrderItems are shared platform constants, not persona-specific)

happyHourBoundaryInstants.note: This brand's happy hour is 14:00-17:00 America/New_York (persona.json pricing.happyHour). The first four instants use a summer date (2026-07-04, EDT/-04:00); the last two are a winter (EST/-05:00) instant pair, mirroring the reference golden file's DST-boundary coverage.

one second before the window opens (winter/EST)

Standalone eligible cold beverage, no happy hour, full price
